description: Verified tactics database for AI Transformation Readiness synthesis. Each tactic maps a detected readiness gap or anti-pattern to a solution mechanism.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Establish an AI operating rhythm with decision-rights matrix, intake cadence, risk triage, decision log, and escalation boundaries.
tactics.case_study: READY-AND-ADAPT: Uses a monthly strategy-to-learning cadence and weekly portfolio triage to keep AI work moving with auditable decisions.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Classify AI demand by predictability, uncertainty, risk, and value. Route predictable automation through standard delivery and uncertain work through Launch-and-Learn slices.
tactics.case_study: READY-AND-ADAPT: Separates predictable work from exploratory AI so teams do not force experiments into fixed-scope delivery.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Run bounded vertical slices with explicit learning goals, production-readiness criteria, safety evidence, and a conversion path into reusable patterns.
tactics.case_study: LAUNCH-AND-LEARN: Validates a safe service slice before scaling the operating model, architecture, data, and governance.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Create communities, chapters, incident reviews, failure libraries, reusable playbooks, and cross-functional learning rituals.
tactics.case_study: COMMUNITIES OF KNOWLEDGE: Converts pilot lessons and incidents into practices shared across business, data, platform, and service teams.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.
tactics.risk_notes: Do not prescribe beyond verified gaps; scale only after control and value evidence exist.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Redesign roles, handoffs, review points, human-in-the-loop responsibilities, and experience metrics before scaling AI into work.
tactics.case_study: IMPACT BEFORE OUTPUT: Moves capacity toward higher-value work and measures quality, cognitive load, and customer impact after AI introduction.
tactics.expected_outcome: Evidence-backed readiness improvement with measurable operating proof.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Expose legacy systems through governed APIs, events, service boundaries, connector standards, versioning, ownership, and failure-mode documentation.
tactics.case_study: BUSINESS ARCHITECTURE INTEGRATION: AI becomes a component of service architecture rather than a layer of brittle point integrations.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Version models, prompts, agents, tools, datasets, configs, and evaluation suites through build-test-deploy-monitor-rollback controls.
tactics.case_study: AI LIFECYCLE CONTROL: Makes production behavior traceable to release, prompt, tool, model, data, and evaluation versions.

tactics.solution_mechanism: Define forbidden actions, data boundaries, tool permissions, escalation paths, adversarial tests, and human override for agents and AI workflows.
